text:
carla: Hey team – we received an invoice from NOME SRL (Italy) that includes 22% VAT for consulting billed to ACME EU. Sales says ACME asserted reverse charge. Need confirmation on what to ask vendor and whether finance can clear the hold.

carla: Invoice excerpt: Invoice: INV-2026-0421; Vendor: NOME SRL, VAT IT12345678901; Customer: ACME LTD; Amount: €10,000; VAT (22%): €2,200; Total: €12,200.

mike: Can you get the customer's VAT ID? Reverse charge only applies B2B with a valid VAT number. If ACME is B2B, vendor should zero-rate and reference reverse charge. :thumbsup:

giovanni: Hi all, Giovanni from NOME SRL here. We charged VAT because we didn't receive the buyer VAT ID on purchase. If you provide ACME's VAT number + VIES check, we can reissue without VAT. PDF attached originally.

sarah: Tax: We need ACME's VAT ID and evidence of B2B status (VIES validation screenshot is fine). For reverse charge seller should show buyer VAT ID and state "inversione contabile / reverse charge" on the invoice and cite the legal basis (e.g., art. 17 D.P.R. 633/72). If vendor reissues we can pay net amount. If not, we'll pay VAT and reclaim via VAT return (slower).

carla: @mike can you ping Sales for ACME contact and VAT?

mike: On it, pinging @lina-sales now.

invoicebot: Invoice INV-2026-0421 uploaded to NetSuite. Flag: VAT discrepancy (holding payment).

lina-sales: ACME VAT: EU987654321 – attaching VIES validation screenshot now. They confirmed B2B and sent PO referencing Redwood account.

mike: Thanks — VIES shows VALID. Giovanni, please reissue with no VAT, include buyer VAT EU987654321 and add text: "reverse charge / inversione contabile – buyer liable for VAT" and reference the legal clause. Once corrected invoice received, finance will release the hold.

giovanni: Understood. I'll reissue and send corrected invoice by EOD with buyer VAT and reverse charge note.

sarah: When corrected invoice is received, finance: match to PO, update vendor ledger, clear VAT hold, and save VIES screenshot to audit folder.

carla: Great — closing once reissue received. :white_check_mark:
